content: Raɛut deg iyyar n Buɛaz
Naɛumi tuɣa ɣares ijjen zi řaǧ n weryaz nnes, ijj n weryaz s waṭṭas n wagřa, zi řaǧ n Alimalik, ttřaɣan as Buɛaz.
Tenna Raɛut Tamu’abect i Naɛumi: “Ejj ayi ad ffɣeɣ ɣar iyyar ad ssmuneɣ tidrin awarni i wenni i ɣa yafeɣ arḍa di tiṭṭawin nnes.” Uca nettat tarra-dd xas: “Uyur, yeǧi!”
Raɛut tuyur uca tusa-dd din, tessmuna awarni i yinni imejjaren. Uca imsar, tewḍa as-dd tesɣart n yeyyar n Buɛaz wenni zi řaǧ n Alimalik.
U xzar, yusa-dd Buɛaz zi Bayt-Laḥm, inna i yinni imejjaren: “SIDI akidwem!” Nitni arrin-dd xas: “SIDI ad cek ibarek!”
Xenni inna Buɛaz i umsexxar nnes wenni tuɣa x yinni imejjaren: “Umi tegga yeǧis taḥenjirt nni?”
Amsexxar wenni tuɣa x yinni imejjaren, yarra-dd xas, inna: “Nettat d taḥenjirt Tamu’abect i dd-yusin ak-d Naɛumi zeg iyyar n Mu’ab.
Nettat tenna: ‘Ejj ayi ad ssmuneɣ tidrin u ad yarweɣ tidrin ɣar icuwwafen n imendi awarni i yinni imejjaren!’ Ammu i dd-tusa uca teqqim zeg uteffu n řḥař ař řexxu. Drus waha i teqqim di taddart.”
Buɛaz inna i Raɛut: “Sḥes ɣari, a yeǧi! War třeqqḍed uřa ɣar ijj n yeyyar nneɣni, war ttaggʷej zi ssa, maca qqim tudsed ɣar temsexxarin inu.

Tebbet tiṭṭawin nnem deg iyyar aya mani mejjaren, uyur awarni asent. Necc ɛeřmeɣ i imsexxaren inu, war cem ttḥidin. Mařa teffuded, tzemmared ad tuyured ɣar iqubac ad teswed zi min d yuymen imsexxaren.”
Nettat tewḍa x wudem nnes uca tuḍar ɣar temmurt, tenna as: “Mayemmi ufiɣ arḍa di tiṭṭawin nnec, aqa cek tbedded akidi, waxxa necc d tabarranit?”

Buɛaz yarra-dd xas, inna: “Aqa nnan ayi nican marra min teggid i lallam awarni i řmewt n weryaz nnem, mammec teggid tsemḥed di babam d yemmam d temmurt nnem mani txeřqed uca tuyured ɣar ijj n řgens i war t tessined qbeř.
Ad cem ixeǧeṣ SIDI n Israil tasexxart nnem taṣebḥant i teggid uca ad am dd-tas řmunet teccur zi SIDI, AREBBI n Israil, sadu ifriwen nnes i dd-tusid maḥend ad dinni tedduryed.”
Nettat tenna: “Ejj ayi ad afeɣ arḍa di tiṭṭawin nnec, a sidi inu, minzi tessfewwjed xafi, tessiwřed ɣar wuř n tayya nnec, waxxa necc war ǧiɣ am uřa d ict zi tiyya nnec.”
Ɣar řḥař n macca inna as Buɛaz: “As-dd da uca ecc zeg weɣrum, sisen ařeqquz nnem di řxeǧ!” Nettat teqqim zzat i yinni imejjaren uca iwca as netta tiɣwawin, tecca tejjiwen, iceṭṭ xas ɛad.
Ařami tekkar ḥima ad tessmun tidrin, iɛřem Buɛaz i imsexxaren nnes: “Ejj i-tt ad tessmun jar icuwwafen n imendi u war tt tesseḥqaram ca!
Ɣeḍřem as-dd cwayt cwayt zi tqebbiḍin uca jjem tt di tammurt, uca jjem tt ad tessmun aya, war tt tzawarem.”
Uca nettat tuɣa třeqqeḍ deg iyyar nni ař tameddit. Xenni tṣeffa min tuɣa teřqeḍ. Tuɣa ɛřaḥař řqedd n ijj n ifa n imendi.
Nettat tessmun i-t, tudef ɣar tendint uca teẓra lallas min tuɣa teřqeḍ. Tejbed ɛawed min tuɣa iceṭṭen zi macca nnes tameqqrant uca tewca as t.

Xenni tesseqsa lallas: “Mani třeqḍed ass-a u mani txedmed? Ad ittwabarek wenni tuɣa akidem ibedden!” Uca nettat tḥaja as i lallas wi i ɣar tuɣa texdem, tenna: “Aryaz i ɣar xedmeɣ ass-a ttřaɣan as Buɛaz.”

Xenni tenna Naɛumi i tesřift nnes: “Ad ittwabarek SIDI wenni war ikkisen tamexsiwt nnes icewwaren zeg yinni iddaren d yinni immuten!” Tenna as Naɛumi ɛawed: “Aryaz nni zzayneɣ, netta d ijj zeg imefdiyyen nneɣ inni zemmaren ad sɣen afedday.”
Raɛut, Tamu’abect, tenna: “Netta inna ayi ɛad: ‘Qqim ɣar imsexxaren nni ɣari iǧan, ař ɣa kemmřen ad ssmunen marra tamegra nni ɣari iǧan.’”
Tenna Naɛumi i tesřift nnes Raɛut: “Mliḥ, a yeǧi, mařa teffɣed cem ak-d temsexxarin nnes, xenni war iǧi wi cem i ɣa ihewřen deg iyyar nneɣni.”
Raɛut teqqim tudes i temsexxarin n Buɛaz ḥima ad tessmun tidrin, ařami teqḍa tmeyra n imendi d tmeyra n irden uca teqqim tezdeɣ ɣar lallas.

footnotes.text: amefdi - imefdiyyen- wenni izemmaren ad ifekk afday u ad idweř ɛawed ɣar twacunt i ɣar iǧa wefday d agřa n zic.
